blocks.body: # VisionQC ModelOps PatchCore 双产品评测状态

## Technical Summary

Both product-specific PatchCore paths completed Anomalib/PyTorch DEMO_SYNTHETIC smoke runs with package verification, feature-bank export and single-image inference. The transistor OFFICIAL_BENCHMARK result is maintained in the source-scoped pilot-qualification package and is BENCHMARK_NO_GO; this smoke artifact makes no customer, factory or production performance claim.

## Implementation evidence is complete; quality evidence is not

The chart counts implementation-contract smoke runs only. Both rows are synthetic, each uses four test images, and both threshold calibrations failed the configured hold-recall constraint. The correct release decision is to keep both candidates out of ACTIVE until authorized MVTec and customer evidence is available.

## Product comparison and audit fields

The table preserves model identity, DEMO_SYNTHETIC metric context, threshold status and warm latency. Synthetic AUROC/AUPRO values are not comparable to OFFICIAL_BENCHMARK or customer results and must not be used as a release gate.

## Limitations and release recommendation

MVTec AD is non-commercial research data. This smoke artifact intentionally contains no optional source bytes; the controlled import, fixed manifest and SHA-256 checks are implemented, and the source-scoped transistor report is BENCHMARK_NO_GO. Keep both products at DRAFT; benchmark can only yield BENCHMARK_PASS / READY_FOR_CUSTOMER_DATA, while CUSTOMER_PILOT requires provenance, gate, approval evidence and rollback conditions. Anomaly evidence is not a confirmed defect type or root cause.

accessIssues.message: This visualization artifact intentionally contains no optional benchmark bytes; use the source-scoped pilot-qualification package for the read-only transistor benchmark result, or obtain an authorized archive through the official MVTec download flow for another run.
